title: Rentokil Initial - acquisition of the hygiene and washroom services business of SGS Australia Pty Ltd - Pink Healthcare

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under merger review process guidelines
ACCC announced its decision to not oppose the acquisition

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the impact of the acquisition in regional markets for washroom and hygiene services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition would be unlikely to substantially lessen competition on the basis of low barriers to entry, the ability of customers to switch service providers combined with the existence of other service providers in the relevant markets.
